apps.name: Soccer Stats
apps.subtitle: Track goals, assists, and match stats
apps.localizedDescription: Track your player’s goals, assists, and match stats across seasons, and score games live from the sideline.

versions.localizedDescription:
- The screen stays awake on the live scoring page, so the phone doesn't
  lock mid-game

- Live scoring screen: score a game as it happens with big Goal, Assist,
  Missed shot, card and Opponent goal buttons, a running score, 1st/2nd half
  switch, play-by-play with Undo, and a Stats tab
- Tapping Goal asks who scored: your player, a teammate, or a teammate
  assisted by your player
- "Start match" now opens the live scoring screen, and every match has a
  Live button
- App version shown at the bottom of the Seasons screen
